entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. Order number is 772-B-901.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... 772-B-901. I see it here. Just to understand the situation, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's neither. I tried to return this over a week ago, but your whole system was down. I just want the return label I should have gotten then.
I see. You're saying you attempted the return online but encountered an issue?
Yes, a major website error. The page wouldn't load. I couldn't print anything because the portal was completely inaccessible. I have a screenshot of the error page if you need it.

Thank you for clarifying. Let me check the records for that timeframe... Yes, I do see a note about a system-wide outage on our returns portal about nine days ago. That matches what you're describing.
Right. So can I return it or not?
Absolutely. I'm just checking the delivery date here... it was delivered 18 days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days to make a return. You're well within that window.
Great. Just email me the label.
Of course. I've just processed the return authorization for you. The prepaid shipping label is on its way to your email on file right now. Is there anything else I can assist with?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
